meta.title: Production AI Engineering

home.hero_subtitle: Learn how production AI systems are designed, built, deployed and maintained.
home.core_pattern_desc: There are countless tutorials showing how to build an agent in 100 lines of code. Very few explain how that agent evolves into a production system with retries, checkpoints, queues, background workers, state persistence, deployments, monitoring, evaluation, and long-running workflows. This repository bridges that gap.
home.learning_path_desc: Progress from foundational primitives to enterprise-grade production patterns and complete platforms.
home.layers_desc: Our curriculum is structured into three logical phases to guide backend and AI engineers.
home.message_flow_desc: Explore the structural progression of standard production-grade agent loops.
